description:
`apply` in `crates/gf2-sim/src/channels/{awgn,rayleigh,rician}.rs` asserts against `FRAME_STRIDE - 256`, while `parallel::DEBUG_ASSERT_WORD_MARGIN` is 1024; it also budgets a multi-frame batch against one frame's stride.

## Background

Reported by the gf2-sim comment sweep. `@/inv/deterministic-seeded-execution` depends on per-frame stream budgets holding.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: The channels use the shared margin constant and budget per frame, with a test at the boundary.
title: Channel apply stride-margin assertion disagrees with the shared word margin
